response.overview: Yes, Seabourn can help coordinate separate cruise reservations. You must call ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] Seabourn Cruise Line and provide both booking numbers when requesting that reservations be linked ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] or noted together. Explain that the guests are travelling together and ask the representative to review the bookings. ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] If you also need connecting cabins, make that request during the same call. Provide both booking numbers when asking Seabourn to associate reservations. Calling ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] customer service also lets you request connecting cabins or other arrangements for your group.
